name: blender-connector
description: Lets Claude work in your open Blender session: inspect the scene, run Python, screenshot the viewport and render.
long_description: Pairs with the Claude Blender Bridge add-on. The add-on listens on 127.0.0.1 inside Blender; this extension forwards Claude's tool calls to it. Nothing leaves your computer except what Claude reads back through the tools.

tools.name: blender_status
tools.description: Check that Blender is open and the bridge add-on is listening

port.title: Blender bridge port
port.description: Must match the port shown in Blender's Claude sidebar tab
